_readme: Faith Works events, rendered on /workshops/ (and the next one on Home and /learn/) by tools/build.mjs. Brief §2: upcoming and past are separated; every event shows date, Asia/Manila time, venue, delivery format, capacity/status and a CTA. Brief §4: September and early-October 2026 campaigns are PAST. DESTINATION (each event keeps its own): destination.type = 'external' (its own page or registration funnel, e.g. a GHL funnel; opens in a new tab and is labelled as external) | 'internal' (a page on this site) | 'notify' (no page yet: the CTA goes to the notify form on /workshops/#notify) | 'none'. Never invent a URL: leave url null and use 'notify'. STATUS: open | waitlist | sold-out | tba | past. Times are Asia/Manila (PHT, UTC+8). PUBLISHING MODEL: whether events keep individual external pages or move to one internal template is NEEDS CLARIFICATION (see docs/04).
